description: Dynamic package counts (Task 4). Add dynamic total counts next to the package tab headings in Packages.tsx based on fetched data array lengths.
steps: In healthcamp-client/src/pages/packages/Packages.tsx, the Available Packages tab gets data from the 'packages' query (data?.packages array). For this tab, display the count as 'Available Packages (X)' where X is data?.packages?.length or 0.

For the Approved, Pending, and Rejected tabs, the count comes from the selectedPackage array fetched via getPackageByStatus. However, there's a challenge: the count for each status requires fetching data for that status. Implement one of these approaches: (a) Fetch counts for all statuses upfront using separate queries, or (b) Display the count only for the currently active tab from selectedPackage?.length.

The optimal approach given the existing code: add separate useQuery hooks for each status (approved, pending, reject) that fetch the counts. Display them in the tab labels: 'Approved Packages (X)', 'Pending Packages (X)', 'Rejected Packages (X)'. Use the existing getPackageByStatus endpoint.
Update each Tabs.Tab value to include the count: e.g., <Tabs.Tab value='available'>Available Packages ({data?.packages?.length || 0})</Tabs.Tab>
acceptance_criteria: Available Packages tab shows dynamic count: 'Available Packages (X)'
Approved Packages tab shows dynamic count: 'Approved Packages (X)'
Pending Packages tab shows dynamic count: 'Pending Packages (X)'
Rejected Packages tab shows dynamic count: 'Rejected Packages (X)'
Counts update dynamically based on actual data array lengths
Counts show 0 when no data is available for that status
verification: Run npx tsc --noEmit in healthcamp-client directory to verify no TypeScript errors
findings: Implementation straightforward. Added three separate useQuery hooks for approved, pending, and reject statuses. TypeScript compilation passes cleanly with no errors.
